policies.title: Attendance Policy
policies.content: Students must maintain minimum 75% attendance to be eligible for certification. Below 85% triggers a yellow warning. Below 75% triggers an orange warning with guardian notification. Below 60% triggers a red alert with escalation to the Director. Three consecutive absences result in an automatic red alert and guardian notification.

policies.title: Fee Payment Policy
policies.content: Fees are due within 30 days of batch start date. Late payments: 7 days overdue triggers a yellow reminder. 15 days overdue triggers an orange warning with guardian notification. 30 days overdue triggers a red alert with suspension warning. Partial payments are accepted and tracked.

policies.title: Examination Policy
policies.content: Each batch has quizzes, midterm, and final exams. Grading: A (90%+), B (80-89%), C (70-79%), D (60-69%), F (below 60%). Students must pass the final exam to receive certification. Re-examination is allowed once.

policies.title: Lab Usage Policy
policies.content: Labs must be booked in advance. Equipment must be handled carefully. Any damage must be reported immediately. Lab hours: 9 AM to 6 PM on weekdays, 9 AM to 2 PM on Saturdays. Students can book individual practice sessions outside class hours.

policies.title: About Corvit Systems
policies.content: Corvit Systems is a premier IT training institute located in Peshawar, Pakistan. Founded with the mission to bridge the IT skills gap, Corvit offers industry-recognized certification courses in Networking, Cybersecurity, AI/ML, Cloud Computing, and Web Development. Our hands-on approach with real equipment and expert instructors ensures students are job-ready.

policies.title: Admission Process
policies.content: Admissions are open throughout the year on a rolling basis. Students can apply online or visit the campus. Requirements: CNIC copy, passport photos, educational certificates. After registration, students are assigned to the next available batch for their chosen course.
